summary: Revise at 6.5 (round 1: 6.2, Caiman: 7, ship bar: 7.5; Corvus was cut at 6.6). Every gate the ring's section names is green and checked against report.json and template-gate.json. The draft cold reload now runs (true), and the false 'no undercut anywhere' field note is gone. The wall census (cad::measure::thickness at 0.8, about 341k rays per build) finds 0 walls and 0 unresolved samples. Under the lead's interim rule, the edges it reports are read, not gated. Two things improved. The theme now runs face to palm: a 33-bay pointed arcade circles both side walls. And the spout pipe, with its bore, now shows in the hero. Most of the art punch list did not move. The sculpt is the same inflated cartoon bulldog: sausage horns, blunt rod fangs and mitten paws. stones.png is still covered in star-shaped decimation flecks, with 175k faces at 0.006 against the at least 400k at 0.003 asked for. The 'wings' are still stepped chevron fans, which read as ziggurats or a crest from above. The perch is still a thin-walled box with no cornice and no quatrefoil, and its three front lancets are faceted. The crown gutter does not show anywhere outside the perch, and the outer palm face is bare polished metal. At 300 px the side-wall arcade reads as gear teeth or a scalloped rim, not as Gothic lancets. 'Gargoyle' still comes first, but as a toy grotesque, not a carved Gothic one. Round 3 is the last. It can reach 7.5 only if the head is re-carved as stone, the wings become bat wings, and the surface is clean. Every item below is needed.
strengths: The subject still reads first at 300 px: a beast gripping a ledge, with a pipe spout thrust out along the finger in face-300. Nobody would say dragon or hood ornament.
Round-1 item 8 is done. In hero.png and hero-300 the spout tube and its bore now project from the open jaws, and side.png shows it head-on as a true waterspout.
The theme now runs face to palm: a 33-bay pointed blind arcade (cells 2.23 x 1.75 mm, ribs 0.95 mm) circles both side walls without a break (side.png, palm.png, reverse.png).
Gate hygiene from round 1 is fixed: draft_build.cold_reload_identical is true, and the field notes no longer contradict each other.
The silhouette is still the most distinct in Tenebrae: 13.4 mm above the coping, with the head 11.9 mm past the coping edge.
Geometry is clean at both builds: watertight, 0 degenerates and 0 crossings on the ring, the sculpt and the pattern, and nothing in the bore (nearest vertex 9.300 mm).

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The side-wall arcade runs the full circumference (palm.png, reverse.png), so the theme no longer stops at the shoulders. This pass is narrow: the outer palm face itself is plain polished metal, and the crown gutter the section asks for does not show outside the perch.

checklist.item: Reads as its Gothic subject at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: From the pair a jeweller says 'gargoyle' first: hero-300 shows a snarling beast over a ledge, and face-300 shows a head thrust out past a block with a spout. The 'Gothic cathedral' half is still weak. The perch reads as a box, and at 300 px the band arcade reads as gear teeth or a cog rim, not lancets.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, with no combing, smearing or stair-steps
checklist.reason: stones.png is still covered in star-shaped decimation flecks over the brow, cheeks, fangs, paws and the spout lip, which is faceted. Round-1 item 3 is not done: decimation was set to 245k at 0.006 and the sculpt has 175,566 faces. The perch-front lancets in side.png are still smudged and faceted, and the spine has a lumpy hammered texture (face.png) that reads as noise, not scale.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, à jour, coloured as stained glass
checklist.reason: Not applicable: the section specifies no stones, and the record shows 0 reported and 0 previewed.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms are sculpted
checklist.reason: The figure is still inflated and balloon-like, a toy or vinyl finish with no carved planes or undercuts. Round-1 item 4 is not done: the fangs are rounded rods, the paws are mittens of four sausages, and the horns are capsules. The perch has thin plate walls and frames (hero.png, shoulder.png) that read as sheet metal. The wing chevrons are mechanical stepped boxes.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: a procedural keyed band, as the section specifies.

checklist.item: Distinct silhouette; custom head at least 13 mm; shoulder ornament not cut off before the face
checklist.reason: It is the only figure in the round in Tenebrae: 13.39 mm above the coping, with a box of 13.3 x 22.3 mm. The arcade runs into the perch without a cut-off.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large forms (body, head) and medium ones (paws, horns, arcade bays) are present, but the small form is missing. The outer band surface is bare everywhere outside the perch, and the beast has no chisel or skin texture beyond lumps on the spine. Caiman carries three scales of crisp detail over the whole outer surface. This ring carries two, over the figure and the side walls only.

gates.gate: Finished mesh watertight, 0 degenerate faces, 0 self-crossings (draft and export)
gates.verified: draft 643,012 triangles and export 1,475,984: watertight true, degenerate_faces 0, self_crossings 0.

gates.gate: Every made part closed and uncrossed
gates.verified: The sculpt has open_edges 0 and self_crossings 0, and made_part_crossings for 'Grow the gargoyle and its parapet out of the band' is 0 at both builds.

gates.gate: Solids notes empty, every feature Ok
gates.verified: notes [], features_not_ok [], parts_joined 1 at both builds.
vertices_inside 0, nearest vertex 9.300 mm against a 9.3 mm bore radius at both builds.

gates.gate: Lost-wax field verdict Castable at 0.8 mm fill
gates.verified: verdict and band_verdict both 'Castable', thinnest wall 2.30 mm, draft.min_section_mm 0.8. The notes now report the 356.9 mm² two-part undercut honestly, with no contradicting note.

gates.gate: cad::measure::thickness at 0.8 mm (the wall census, lead's interim rule)
gates.verified: draft: 340,985 rays; export: 340,768 rays. Both: assessed true, walls [], wall_area 0, unresolved 0, internal 0, suspected_census_artifacts []. Edges reported as read: 2,156 samples over 12.1 mm² at export. The worst edges are the pair at (±3.9, 25.9, 10.0), thinnest 0.097 mm over 0.62 mm depth (horn or ear tips), the tips at (1.23, 27.06, 9.54) at 0.0025 mm and (-2.21, 26.81, 9.35) at 0.012 mm, and the side-wall arcade rib lips at (±9.5, 6.6, ±2.8), 0.32-0.35 mm over 4-7 mm spans. Under the interim rule these do not gate, but they are knife edges at the crown of the head (punch item 5).

gates.claimed: Reported only (gate false); the section names the wall census as the gate.
gates.verified: thinnest_mm 0.00042 and under_floor_mm2 5.63, up from 4.71 in round 1. The method counts the part's buried foot, so the near-zero reading is not by itself a cast wall. Accepted as a report, not a gate, because the ring's section names only the census. Round-1 item 1's acceptance (part_sections = 0) is not met.
draft_build.cold_reload_identical true and export_build.cold_reload_identical true (round-1 item 2 done).
pattern watertight, 0 degenerates, 0 self-crossings, 1,475,984 triangles at export.

gates.gate: Template gate: at most 4 design.set patches within the class budget
gates.verified: template-gate.json: 0 patches, 1,920,633 bytes against the 3,000,000 painted budget (the stored-sculpt precedent). Source and vertices/faces/normals identical, cold design and graph reloads true, export geometry verified, 1,475,984 triangles, first open 9.3 s.

punch_list.priority: high (carried from round 1, item 3; not done)
punch_list.zone: Whole sculpt surface: brow, muzzle, cheeks, fangs, forepaws, spout lip, wing chevrons (stones.png)
punch_list.change: Remove the star flecks and creases. Raise the decimation target to at least 450k faces at a tolerance of at most 0.003, then re-settle against the field. The export has about 520k triangles of headroom under 2M. Rebuild the spout lip as a clean CAD tube end (revolve), not a sculpt edge.
punch_list.acceptance: stones.png at full size shows unbroken highlights over brow, cheek, fang and paw with no star-shaped flecks or crease lines. The spout lip is a crisp round with no facets. Export stays at or under 2,000,000 triangles.

punch_list.priority: high (carried from round 1, item 4; not done)
punch_list.change: Carve the head from inflated bulldog into stone grotesque. Cut a hard brow ridge overhanging the eye sockets by 0.6-0.8 mm. Make the cheek and snout planes flat-faceted, with 2-3 furrows each side at least 0.3 mm deep. Taper the fangs and horns to points, cones ending at a 0.85 mm section, not capsules. Give each paw a wrist and 3-4 separate hooked claws curling over the coping's front edge, each at least 0.85 mm at the base, with a visible gap between claws.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero.png the brow casts a hard shadow across the sockets, fangs and horns end in points, and separate hooked claws curl over the coping. In hero-300 a reader says 'stone gargoyle', not 'cartoon dog' or 'foo dog'.

punch_list.priority: high (carried from round 1, item 5 and read-test 2, item 3; not done twice)
punch_list.zone: Back, y ±1.5 to ±3.5 mm, the stepped chevrons seen in face.png
punch_list.change: Remove the stepped chevron fans. Sculpt two folded bat wings lying along either side of the spine. Each wing gets a forearm bone with a hooked thumb claw at the wrist and 3-4 finger bones fanning back, with a scalloped trailing edge between them. Recess the membranes 0.3-0.5 mm below the bones. Replace the hammered spine texture with a row of 6-8 discrete dorsal knobs.
punch_list.acceptance: In face-300 two separate wing shapes with scalloped trailing edges lie either side of the spine, and nothing reads as steps, a ziggurat, a fan or a crest.

punch_list.priority: high (carried from round 1, item 6; not done)
punch_list.zone: Perch: the cornice round the front and both sides, the corbel, and the side faces
punch_list.change: Replace the thin plate walls and frames with a solid moulded block. Give it a two-step cornice round the front and both sides, each step overhanging 0.8-1.0 mm with a hollow (cavetto) under it, over a corbel tapering into the band. Cut a blind quatrefoil 0.5-0.7 mm deep, about 3 mm across, into each side face. Recut the three front lancets as CAD pockets (not sculpt) at least 1.5 mm tall with crisp pointed heads.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero-300 and face-300 the block shows a lit cornice edge over a shadow band and does not read as a box. In side.png and shoulder.png a crisp quatrefoil shows on the side face, and the lancets have unfaceted pointed heads.

punch_list.zone: Crown of the head: the edge zones at (±3.9, 25.9, 10.0) and the tips near (1.23, 27.06, 9.54) and (-2.21, 26.81, 9.35); the arcade rib lips at (±9.5, 6.6, ±2.8)
punch_list.change: Blunt the horn and ear tips so no edge closes under 0.3 mm within 0.6 mm of its tip: finish each on a 0.4 mm radius ball. Round the arcade rib lips to a 0.15 mm radius.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json export thickness_0_8.edges shows no zone thinner than 0.3 mm. walls stays [] and unresolved 0.

punch_list.zone: Outer band face, all theta outside the perch footprint; side-wall arcade
punch_list.change: Make the crown gutter section-visible all round: 0.9 mm wide and 0.4 mm deep, centred on the outer face from the perch's back round the palm, with a 0.2 mm roll moulding along each lip. Read the arcade as architecture, not teeth: cut a 0.3 mm deep sunken field inside each pointed bay, and add a continuous 0.5 mm string-course bead along the top of the arches so they stand under a moulding.
punch_list.acceptance: palm.png and reverse.png show the gutter and its two beads continuous over the whole outer palm face, with no plain polished outer surface longer than 8 mm. At 300 px (contact-300) the side walls read as an arcade under a moulding, not a gear or cog.
